name: Internalization TTT-LoRA training design
purpose: Insert a careful training-design gate before converting traces to datasets or training adapters. The design adopts a test-time-training style LoRA program while preserving the internalization definition: the external register/controller must eventually be removed, and fast LoRA updates may not use oracle actions or official scores at evaluation time.

code_added_used.change: Defines static policy LoRA, episode/agent fast TTT LoRA, allowed/disallowed test-time losses, curriculum stages, required controls, and updated item routing before any training.

commands.purpose: Record the training design and TTT-LoRA constraints before building datasets or training adapters.

headline.core_decision: Use static LoRA as an offline policy prior, fast TTT LoRA as resettable episode/agent adaptation state, and textual bounded register as the only reversible search stack.
headline.why_not_fast_lora_as_stack: Prior TTT diagnostic shows gradient fast weights are not cleanly reversible; rollback semantics must live in bounded text and be consistency-checked.
headline.next_artifact: trace-to-SFT and TTT auxiliary dataset builder
headline.allowed_test_time_update_signal: visible-state reconstruction and consistency only; no oracle target_action and no official score.

gate_outcomes.number: Spec defines theta_static, delta_theta_ep, and textual bounded register as separate state carriers.
Allowed test-time losses are visible-state reconstruction, local consistency, register serialization, rollback text consistency, and message roundtrip consistency.
Spec forbids oracle target_action, official score, hidden full assignment, and unrendered scaffold state in test-time updates.
Spec requires frozen, static-only, no-update, shuffled-aux, no-rollback, oracle-scaffold, monolith-R, and monolith-KR controls.
Spec revises Item099-106 route so training design precedes dataset builder.

decision.next_step_routing: Proceed to Item100: build episode-split action SFT and TTT auxiliary datasets from Items097-098 traces with split hashes, leakage checks, and action coverage accounting.

honesty.does_not_establish: This is a training design item only. It does not build datasets, train LoRA adapters, run test-time updates, or evaluate internalized agents.
honesty.ttt_limit: TTT-LoRA is proposed as adaptive policy state, not as a reversible stack. A future item must empirically test whether fast updates help beyond static LoRA.
honesty.route_revision_limit: This item revises the Item096 route by inserting training design before dataset building; future deviations require their own item and gates.
